chapters.d: Your day in Asmara starts with an executive summary waiting on Telegram. While you slept, your Ceyo bot inspected global commodity indexes and logged foreign exchange shifts into Google Sheets.

While meetings take you around Harnet Avenue, your cloud browser scrapes regional supplier quotes and tests a client's web app repository. It works tirelessly in its isolated environment without draining your phone battery.

Your specialist bots collaborate in a shared Telegram group to generate a multi-page research dossier on regional supply chains. They verify data sources, synthesize key findings, and alert you only when decisions are required.
You shut down your laptop and power off your mobile device for the night. Your Ceyo agent remains online in the cloud, monitoring servers, compiling scheduled routines, and guarding your workflows.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in Eritrea and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial offering up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; an international payment card is linked during signup and is only charged once the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Does my Ceyo bot keep running if local connectivity cuts out?
faq.a: Yes. Every Ceyo bot operates on its own dedicated, isolated cloud computer with high-speed global connectivity. It continues executing scheduled browser searches, server testing, and data workflows even if your local network disconnects or your phone is off.

faq.q: Can I interact with my Ceyo bots directly through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, you can operate your bots through 1-on-1 Telegram chats or add multiple specialized bots into group chats. In groups, your bots collaborate, divide complex tasks, and present consolidated updates directly to you.

faq.q: What languages and tools can Ceyo integrate with?
faq.a: Ceyo agents process tasks in English, Arabic, and several other languages. They natively connect to over 1,000 popular services including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, calendars, and external cloud databases.

faq.q: What capabilities do the autonomous browser and coding agents have?
faq.a: The autonomous browser can open websites, fill out forms, track listings, and extract structured data without manual oversight. The coding agent writes, runs, and debugs code directly in its cloud container, allowing you to build and host web software remotely.
